column3: Package manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives v0.2.1-rc.2: ESM, exports lib/index.js plus the raw ./src/* tree, devDeps pin shiki/micromark/katex/anser/simple-icons, peerDep on cordis workspace:~.
Per-heading bilingual pairing hashes (en/zh) for README.md; re-recorded with pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write.
221-line package doc: summary, TOC, component catalogue, source map, input modality, streaming-markdown and geometry/overflow design notes, KV-cache effect, known limitations, dev note.
Chinese translation of README.md, paired by README.i18n.yaml.
ANSI SGR parser: strips OSC/non-CSI escapes, maps the 8/16 basic colours onto --dsw-* tokens, leaves 256/truecolour literal, splits output into styled per-line spans.
Brand wordmark SVG (whale mark + type) at viewBox 182x24, currentColor, with an includeMark toggle.
Button variant and size styles built from --dsw-alias-button-* / radius tokens.
forwardRef button atom: variants primary|ghost|outline|toolbar, sizes md(36px)|sm(28px), optional leading icon, native attributes pass through.
Label-wrapped checkbox styling with a native accent-color and focus ring.
Controlled native checkbox inside a caller-owned visible/accessible label; fully controlled.
writeClipboard: prefers navigator.clipboard.writeText, falls back to a detached readonly textarea + execCommand, returns true only on an accepted write.
Provenance manifest: two internal design exports with sha256 digests covering all 48 code icon categories, plus the excluded 'markdown'.

Vendor artwork blob: 57 KB in 60 lines whose individual lines are up to ~10 KB of embedded SVG path data from an internal design export (48 code-file glyphs keyed by CODE_FILE_TYPES). Read the header, the CODE_FILE_ICON_ID_TOKEN contract and the closing `satisfies Record<CodeFileType,string>` assertion; the path data itself was not read line by line, and code-file-icon.client.spec.tsx pins its safety rules (no script/style/foreignObject, no external href, unique instance-safe ids).
CODE_FILE_TYPES (48 categories) plus filename/prefix/suffix/extension classification tables and the project-context Flutter rule.
Re-exports the shared CODE_HIGHLIGHT_EXTENSIONS/languageForPath from @deepseek-ai/dsh-util-code-language and binds useCodeHighlighter to the lazy shiki singleton.
Shared code-card chrome: banner, icon actions, code body font and scroll rules.
Renders one embedded code-file SVG through dangerouslySetInnerHTML, substituting a per-instance id so gradients/clip paths do not collide.
Shared code-card header: language label, wrap toggle, copy button, each action wrapped in a Tooltip.
Horizontal scrollport rules for command text with a focus-visible ring.
Command text that becomes a named, focusable scrollport (role=group, tabIndex=0) only while it overflows; re-measures on resize and on font loading.
Label/control/reset layout for a config field, with an aria-invalid border and an error note.
Controlled config input: a select for finite choices, a password field for secrets, a textarea otherwise, plus reset and invalid feedback.
Connection indicator styling for the disconnected/connecting/recovered phases and the leaving fade.
Inline reconnect control: outage and retry are one button whose label names the action; recovered is a status; a 150 ms exit fade precedes unmount.
Ambient declarations for *.module.css (Record<string,string> default export) and bare *.css imports.
isDarwinDesktop() reads <html data-platform="darwin">, set by the macOS Electron preload; read at render time.
Diff row styling: path/gap chrome, del/add colour plus inset marker, and the data-code-wrap wrapping mode.
Diff card: structuredPatch hunks with a 256-char edit-graph bound, head/tail line cap (default 16) and diffTotals for +/− counts.
Disclosure row rules on the shared font-size axis (--dsh-content-font-delta), with the leading glyph scaling except StateDot.
Memoised disclosure header: leading chevron/icon toggle, TextShimmer activity, optional accessory, row-level or icon-level expansion.
fileSizeText: compact byte formatter (312B / 4.2KB / 1.5MB / 2.4GB) with one decimal below ten of the unit.
Per-category default palette for the traditional file glyphs, overridable through --dsh-file-type-icon-color.
classifyFileType/fileExtension plus the traditional glyph dispatch; code categories route to the embedded full-colour CodeFileIcon.
Fish logo: the silhouette path exported as a constant (for consumers composing their own svg) plus the component.
focusWithoutRing: automatic focus that suppresses the outline via data-dsh-automatic-focus until Tab/arrow navigation or blur.
Shared head-tail fold button for capped lists: aria-expanded plus caller-localized collapse/expand copy carrying the hidden count.
Two fixed-palette ornamental SVGs (browser, files) for sidebar guide entries.
headTailCap: pure arithmetic for the head/tail split of a capped list (hidden, capped, headLines, tailLines).
Hover-card material, variant geometry and the closing fade rules.
Hover-triggered portaled preview card: dwell delay, pointer grace, group warm-state, focus/selection-aware copy activation, viewport clamping.
Group context that shares the first-display dwell across a list and the active portal, and dismisses the previous card on replacement.

Huge vendored-looking icon catalogue: 114 KB / 1658 lines; 191 export const = 188 Icon* components (94 Regular + 94 Medium) + ICON_REGULAR_STROKE + ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE + SHIELD_OUTLINE_PATH, over 95 artwork names (89 local const Artwork shapes + 6 imported from shared-artwork.tsx, with IconQueueOutlineArtwork a wrapper over the shared ChatLinesOutlineArtwork). Opened lines 1-80, sampled 800-830, counted exports programmatically and read the sibling icons.client.spec.tsx, but the remaining ~1570 lines are the same mechanical path-data pattern and were not read line by line.
IconProps: size and className only; colour rides currentColor.
Six shared currentColor SVG geometries (new-chat, chat lines, globe, code brackets, browse, folder close) reused by product, link and reference icons.
Full-viewport backdrop and stage styling for the image lightbox.
Body-portaled image lightbox: focuses the close control, traps Tab, closes on Escape/backdrop, and restores focus to the opener on unmount.
Contained image frame plus loading/failed status styling.
Passive inline image preview with loading/failed status; keyed by src so a new URL restarts the state.
Public barrel: 119 lines re-exporting every atom, its label types and the settings-form surface.
Inline editor textarea styling for the grow-to-six-lines behaviour.
Auto-growing textarea: Enter saves, Shift+Enter breaks the line, IME composition is ignored (keyCode 229), Escape cancels.
Document-wide pointer/keyboard modality tracker published as data-input-modality; tooltips follow the last input while focus rings follow navigation keys.
Wrapped single-line input with optional leading icon.
forwardRef single-line input with an optional 16px leading icon; native attributes pass through.
JSON tree palette and row mechanics, including a dark-theme override block and the collapsed-string shape.
850-line JSON tree viewer: collapsible nodes, per-row copy menus (value/JSON/path/pretty), a copy store that notifies only the old and new row, and a fixed root row.
observeComposition: an IME composition guard (compositionstart/end plus keyCode 229) with a disposer for its document listeners.
Link category glyphs (url/folder/code/image/document/other) with two stroke weights, plus classifyLinkPath deriving the category from the extension.
micromark extension that lets asterisk strong emphasis close after punctuation when CJK prose continues without whitespace.
Code block card rules: the plain and shiki arms, line grouping and the counter-based line-number gutter.
Code block with two interchangeable arms: a StreamingHighlightSession that re-tokenizes only appended text, and shiki's settled HTML; the streaming tree survives the settle swap.
parseFileLink: decodes a local destination and a GitHub-style #L<n>[-L<m>] range, rejecting URLs, queries, control characters, UNC paths and malformed escapes.
The client's ONE highlighter: a synchronous shiki core on the JavaScript regex engine, three boot grammars plus lazy dynamic imports, a css-variables theme and the StreamingHighlightSession.

Incremental block-level markdown parser: freezes all but the last two blocks, re-parses only the source tail, and keys frozen blocks by their absolute start offset so React reconciles instead of remounting.
Collapsible JSON block toggle and body styling.
Collapsible JSON payload block with a 20 000-character cap and a caller-supplied truncation note.
KaTeX to React via DOMParser, replicating the rehype-katex three-arm error chain (strict render, strict:ignore retry, error span) with no trusted commands.
Recovers only unambiguous, unescaped image-only paragraphs whose local path contains spaces, without changing source offsets.
Context-scoped Markdown navigation capabilities (openExternalLink, openFile, fileImages) so handlers need not be threaded through the renderer.
Markdown typography, table scroll containers, compact variant and the image-button rules.
The renderer facade: a StreamingRenderer that caches frozen blocks as React elements and re-parses only the tail, plus a settled full parse with math and a footnote section.
micromark extension adding TeX backslash delimiters and same-line display-dollar blocks on top of micromark-extension-math's token vocabulary.
The two mdast grammars: streaming GFM (no math, so incomplete TeX never flashes) and settled GFM plus math, both with local-image recovery.
Markdown-to-plain-text projection sharing the renderer's streaming grammar; raw HTML stays literal, links keep labels, images keep alt text.
760-line direct mdast-to-React renderer replacing react-markdown: a protocol allowlist for links and images, raw HTML as literal text, KaTeX without trusted commands, footnote numbering.
One document-wide IntersectionObserver that activates a code surface the first time it intersects, permanently and with the observer released when the last pending block unmounts.
Menu card geometry: the portal z-index above modal overlays, the viewport-fit max-height, the pinned footer and the arrow-navigation fill that replaces the default ring.
564-line menu: data rows and component rows in one keyboard walk, nested submenus, portal mode with rAF anchor tracking, focus return to the trigger and the pointer-grace close.
Sticky group heading styling including the stuck-state treatment.
MenuGroup section plus observeStickyMenuGroups, which marks a heading stuck from two intersection observers (a start sentinel and a top strip) with the newest sample winning.
Menu surface material and the macOS backing layer rules.
Menu material plus a body-portaled opaque backing on macOS, aligned by CSS anchor so nested portals keep the anchor first.
Modal overlay, blurred mask and centred card geometry with a 24px viewport margin.
Body-portaled modal with a blurred mask, headless mode, a data-shortcut-modal scope and the shared useModalLayer keyboard/focus ownership.
overlayTopMargin: the top margin an overlay keeps, widened by the frame's --dsh-frame-top-clearance and reduced to 20px in fullscreen.
Path label styling: muted directory, primary filename and the left-edge clipping fade.
Single-line path label that keeps the trailing characters visible and toggles data-path-clipped when the text overflows.
Four permission glyph families (read-only, workspace write, full access, auto review) in Regular and Medium stroke weights.
Capsule chip geometry for the static and interactive forms.
Capsule that renders a button only when onClick is supplied, otherwise a static span; size separates it from the read-only Tag.
Five fixed-palette plugin artwork SVGs (terminal, loop, subagent, search, default) with per-instance gradient ids.
usePointerGrace: a 200 ms cancelable delayed close so the pointer can cross the anchor-to-popup gap.
rankByName: case-insensitive ordered-subsequence matcher with a boundary/adjacency alignment score, prefix hits first and source order for ties; the / menu's fuzzy discovery.
Read-card row, gutter, content and expand-toggle rules including the wrap mode.
Read card: line-numbered gutter, whole-window highlighting, a "showing N of M" note for a windowed read, head/tail cap and a copy control hidden for an empty file.
Session/file/folder reference glyphs in two stroke weights.
relativeTime: shared relative-time bucketing (now/minutes/hours/days/months/years) so two surfaces naming the same session agree.
Risk confirmation card, warning row and acknowledgement checkbox styling.
Risk acknowledgement dialog: the primary action stays disabled until the caller-controlled checkbox is ticked.
Search card banner, summary, line and file-header styling, with the no-wrap rule for match lines.
Search card with two shapes (grouped matches, flat paths) flattened into one row model so the height cap counts a file header like any other row.
Segmented control tab and sliding-indicator rules.
ARIA tablist of equal segments with one sliding indicator, a roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End walking that skips disabled options, and a controlled owner.
Segmented tab pill and indicator rules.
Equal-width controlled tabs with a sliding indicator; keyboard selection moves focus as well as the selection.
Settings field layout: label group, badges, input, hint/invalid message and the help region.
Staged settings controls: a value field with an overridden badge, reset and disclosure help, and a write-only secret field that never renders the stored value.

SettingsFormModel: the staged form model over user/composition/schema layers, with revision-fenced writes, credential fields written outside the section, and presence (not value equality) marking an override.
Settings form frame, read-only and failure notices and the save row.
Settings form frame: unavailable notice, read-only notice, a save that writes every staged edit, and discard-on-unmount.
Keycap styling for the plain and tooltip variants, including the joined plus-separated combination.
Shortcut keycaps: unboxed by default, one filled block for a plus-separated combination in the tooltip variant.
siteGlyph: simple-icons site marks matched by longest host suffix, riding currentColor instead of the brand fill.
State dot palette and the ongoing spinner (rotating group plus a breathing dash arc), with a reduced-motion fallback.
State dot/spinner; the spinner's CSS animations are pinned to document time zero so every visible loader turns in step.
Switch track and thumb, keyed off aria-checked so the visual state cannot disagree with the accessible one.
role=switch toggle, fully controlled, with a required label and an optional lock-reason title.
Tag capsule geometry plus the eight tone rules (status tones tinted at 10%, warning at 12%).
Read-only capsule badge with eight tones, selected through data-tone; the selectable capsule is Pill.
Terminal output styling: line height variable, scrollbar track margins, the run-state dot centred on one command line and the white-space variable for wrapping.
Terminal card: the prompt line with a collapsed home path, ANSI-rendered output, the exit/signal status pill, the run-state dot and the head/tail line cap.
Shimmer content and the clipped decorative sweep layer.
Activity shimmer that keeps the real text selectable and accessible while a decorative copy carries the highlight; nested instances share the row's activity.
Toast banner geometry and the fade that reads the --dsh-toast-hold custom property.
Transient banner: one hold value drives both the unmount timer and the stylesheet's fade delay, the surface is click-through and only the inline action text takes the pointer.
Tooltip bubble material, the per-side placement offsets and the shortcut keycap row.
Anchor tooltip with observed-size placement, side flipping, viewport clamping, pin-on-click, nested-tooltip suppression and a keyboard-modality-aware show policy.
useCopyFeedback: a one-second transient 'copied' flag over writeClipboard; a refused write stays silent.
Viewport-fit hook for bottom-anchored overlays; the bottom edge is laid out independently so only the top can collide and the height is clamped.
Positions a fixed floating panel from its anchor's viewport rect, clamps it inside the viewport and re-places on scroll, resize and the panel's own size change.
Closes a trigger-owned popover on an outside pointerdown, counting an optional portaled surface as inside.
Modal keyboard ownership: a per-document layer stack gives only the top modal Escape and Tab, restores the previous focus on close, and blocks dismissal behind a newer menu.
Inline reference chip styling, including the code face for skill/command tokens and the 1em reference glyph.
UserTextRun and ReferenceChip: a reference becomes a button only when an activation is supplied, and text selection or a repeated click does not activate it.
Web card source list, answer block and fetch meta styling.
Web retrieval card in two shapes (search with citations, fetch with status); only http(s) becomes a navigable anchor and a label is never blank.
506-line suite pinning every SGR code to its token (basic, bright, 256, truecolor), backgrounds, reverse video, decorations, control-character stripping and multi-line runs.
712-line suite for Button, Pill, Input, Menu, Modal and ConnectionIndicator: menu keyboard walk and wrapping, portal mode and anchor tracking, pointer grace, submenus, focus return, modal layering.
Checkbox label activation, controlled state and the disabled refusal.
highlightToHtml contract, lazy loading of all 57 grammar aliases, alias-coverage over the shared extension table and the copy-failure paths.
Code-card toolbar controls (wrap toggle, copy) across the diff, read and markdown surfaces, including the shared toolbar labels.
Code-file classification tables and the artwork safety contract: no script/style/foreignObject, no external href, unique instance-safe ids, and the manifest digests.
Asserts languageForPath IS the shared table (no local copy) and that both shipped hint projections select the same grammar.
Command text becomes focusable only while overflowing, keeps its scroll position across rerenders and releases its observers.
Config field select/secret/textarea arms, the reset control and the invalid-draft note.
Diff card structure: create/edit/gap rows, the trailing-newline terminator rule, the cap and the copy failure path.
Reads DisclosureRow.module.css as text to assert the font-size-axis declarations (title tier, row/leading delta, StateDot exemption).
Pins the byte formatter's rounding thresholds on both sides of KB/MB/GB.
Reads FileTypeIcon.module.css as text to assert each traditional category's default colour and the single caller override variable.
File-type classification tables and the per-category glyph dispatch.
Settled DOM for nested blockquotes, a quoted list and a trailing paragraph; byte-identical to its streaming twin.
Streaming DOM for the nested-blockquote case; byte-identical to the settled snapshot, so the block freeze does not change the tree.

Settled DOM pinning CJK strong closing after the full-width colon, upstream behaviour for **Notice:** and single-asterisk emphasis, and the inline-code URL promotion (an absolute http(s) code span becomes code>anchor with a globe glyph).
Streaming twin of the CJK-strong and inline-code-URL baseline; byte-identical, so neither behaviour is streaming-gated.

Settled DOM for six fence shapes: a ts fence through shiki, a language-less fence, an unknown-lang fence on the plain arm, a `ts some=meta` fence whose banner shows only "ts" (the lang id is truncated at the first non-word character), an empty fence that renders a bare pre>code with NO card wrapper, and an indented code block that does get the card.

Streaming twin of the fence baseline; differs from the settled snapshot in exactly two ways: the shiki pre has no wrapping div (the streaming arm builds the tree directly) and its style attribute is React's serialization rather than shiki's own string.
Settled DOM for a document holding only an unused reference definition: the wrapper div with no children, so a definition renders nothing and leaves no placeholder.
Streaming twin of the definition-only baseline; byte-identical, so the streaming arm also drops the definition entirely.

Settled DOM for entities and escapes: AT&T, 3 < 4, *not em*, a literal backslash and the copyright sign all land as one text node inside a p, so entities are decoded and escapes resolved before the DOM.
Streaming twin of the entities-and-escapes baseline; byte-identical.

Settled DOM for fences with trailing blank lines: the plain fence keeps its trailing newline in the code text node and the shiki tree ends with empty span.line elements for the two blank lines rather than trimming them.
Streaming twin of the trailing-blank-lines baseline, with the same empty-line structure and the same two differences as code-fences.streaming.txt (no wrapping div, React-serialized styles).

Settled DOM for footnotes: a sup per reference numbered by first-reference order (the reused footnote prints 1 twice), then a section.footnotes with an sr-only h2 and an ol whose li ids are user-content-fn-a/b, and the arrow back-references (two for the reused footnote, the second with a sup 2).
Streaming twin of the footnote baseline; byte-identical, so the footnote section and its numbering are not streaming-gated.

Settled DOM for GFM strikethrough plus autolinks: ~~gone~~ becomes del, www.example.com becomes an anchor normalized to http://www.example.com, and user@example.com becomes a mailto: anchor carrying no target/rel (only http(s) links open externally).
Streaming twin of the strikethrough-and-autolinks baseline; byte-identical.
Settled DOM for hard breaks and a thematic break: both the two-space and the backslash break become a br followed by a newline text node, and --- becomes an hr.
Streaming twin of the hard-breaks baseline; byte-identical.
Settled DOM for a heading immediately followed by a tight list: an h4, a ul whose items are bare text (a tight list unwraps its paragraphs), then an h5 and an ol.
Streaming twin of the heading-tight-against-list baseline; byte-identical, so the tight/loose paragraph-unwrapping rule holds on both arms.
Settled DOM for headings and inline marks: h1 through h6 from ATX, a setext === underline becoming h1 and a --- underline becoming h2, and one paragraph carrying strong, em, del and code.
Streaming twin of the headings-and-paragraphs baseline; byte-identical.

Settled DOM for images: absolute http(s) sources become img with loading=lazy decoding=async referrerpolicy=no-referrer, while a relative source and a javascript: source are replaced by a span carrying the alt text (the destination is dropped, not rendered as a broken image).
Streaming twin of the images baseline; byte-identical, so the image allowlist is not streaming-gated.
Settled DOM for an inline code span crossing a line break: the newline renders as a space, matching mdast-util-to-hast's inline-code rule.
Streaming twin of the inline-code-with-newline baseline; byte-identical.

Settled DOM for the link allowlist in one file: https and mailto: anchors survive; a relative destination and a javascript: destination drop to plain text; uppercase HTTPS:// keeps its anchor with the scheme verbatim; angle-bracket and bare autolinks become anchors; a destination with a literal space is split so the anchor covers only the first part; and an image-only anchor carries no leading globe glyph.
Streaming twin of the links-and-autolinks baseline; byte-identical, so the URL allowlist is not streaming-gated.

Settled DOM for list shapes: a tight ul whose items are bare text, a nested ul inside a tight item, an ol whose items each keep a p (loose), a loose item with two paragraphs, and a list item containing a fenced code block rendered as a full md-code-block card inside the li.
Streaming twin of the lists baseline; byte-identical, so a fence inside a list item renders the same card in both arms.

Settled DOM for the KaTeX edge cases: the untrusted href renders in KaTeX error colour with only the command name (no link is made), the unbalanced formula becomes KaTeX's OWN katex-error span with the ParseError in its title, math renders inside a table cell, and a math fence becomes a katex-display block.

Streaming twin of the math-edge-cases corpus and the clearest record of the two-grammar rule: every TeX construct is literal text, the table cell holds the raw source, and the math fence stays an ordinary plain code block. The delimiters are not merely inert: \(...\) renders as (...\) because the streaming grammar treats them as CommonMark backslash escapes.

Settled DOM for inline and display KaTeX, 320 lines and the largest fixture: inline $E = mc^2$ as a katex span, a $$...$$ display as katex-display, the backslash-delimited inline form rendered as real KaTeX, and the backslash display as a katex-display block, with the original TeX kept in an annotation element.

Streaming twin of the inline-and-display math corpus: 9 lines, every construct literal, with the same delimiter-consumption effect (\(...\) becomes (...), \[...\] becomes [...]) because the streaming grammar registers no math compatibility extension.

Settled DOM proving raw HTML never enters the DOM: the script block, the inline img onerror and the div block all appear as escaped text nodes, and the paragraph's bold tag stays literal. The most security-relevant fixture in the shard.
Streaming twin of the raw-html baseline; byte-identical, so raw HTML is neutralised in the streaming arm too, not just at settle.

Settled DOM for reference links: full, collapsed and shortcut references all resolve to anchors; a missing reference reverts to its bracketed source text and a missing image reference to literal text; a resolvable reference image becomes a normal img with the lazy/async/no-referrer attributes.
Streaming twin of the reference-links baseline; byte-identical, so a reference whose definition is at the end of the document still resolves (the whole document is one frozen block).
Settled DOM for a typical partial stream: an h2 and a ul whose second item holds the literal text **unfinished, so an unclosed emphasis run produces no half-rendered strong element.
Streaming twin of the typical-partial baseline; byte-identical, so an unclosed emphasis run is equally inert while streaming.
Settled DOM for a header-only table: a tableScroll wrapper around a table with a thead and NO tbody, followed by the paragraph after. Pins that a body-less table emits no empty tbody.
Streaming twin of the header-only table baseline; byte-identical.

Settled DOM for the two table geometries: a four-column top-level table gets the wide arm (md-table-wide class plus tabindex=0 so it stays keyboard-reachable), while the same table inside a blockquote falls back to the fill arm with no tabindex. The rule is columns >= 4 and not inside a blockquote.
Streaming twin of the wide-table-and-blockquote baseline; byte-identical, so the wide/fill choice is not streaming-gated.

Settled DOM for table alignment: the delimiter row's alignment renders as an inline text-align style on every cell of that column (a column with no alignment gets no style), a code cell keeps its code, and a link cell keeps the full globe-glyph anchor, all inside the wide arm.
Streaming twin of the table-alignment baseline; byte-identical, so the per-column alignment style is applied identically on both arms.

Settled DOM for GFM task lists: the list gets class contains-task-list, each task item gets class task-list-item, and the checkbox is a real disabled input type=checkbox with checked present only when done — a form control the user cannot toggle. The bold text after a done item keeps its strong.
Streaming twin of the task-lists baseline; byte-identical.
Viewport-gated highlighting: offscreen blocks stay plain, an intersecting block activates once and stays active, the observer is released, and unsupported languages are never observed.
Group dwell sharing: the first display warms the list, later cards switch instantly, a keyboard-opened card does not warm the next pointer visit, and unmounting the group releases every timer.

682-line suite for the hover card: dwell delay, preview insets and frame clearance, the 200 ms grace, copy activation vs text selection, in-flight clipboard writes, inline media previews and viewport clamping.
Icon catalogue invariants: every exported icon is aria-hidden, currentColor-only and distinct.
Lightbox opens from the thumbnail, traps Tab on the close control, closes on Escape and restores focus to the opener.
Inline preview shows the loading state and the failure state without adding a second activation target.
Inline editor: Enter saves, Shift+Enter breaks the line, IME composition does not save, Escape cancels, and the textarea grows with its text.
Modality policy: any key returns tooltips to the keyboard, navigation keys return the focus ring, and refocusing the same control after a modifier stays silent.
475-line suite for the JSON tree: per-row copy menus, no property reads on hover, clipboard settlement ignored after a row change or unmount, and the fixed root row.
Shared localized label dictionaries for the suite (zh-CN copy for every card's copy, collapse/expand and status labels).
Link category classification, currentColor-only artwork, the 14px inline seat and the site-mark resolution by longest host suffix.
Compact variant keeps the body's semantics and keeps frozen blocks and highlighted lines mounted across growth and variant changes.
Fixture-driven DOM compatibility baseline: each corpus case is snapshotted in settled and streaming form and diffs are reviewed as user-visible changes.
Local file links: decoding and #L ranges reach the preview callback, unsupported destinations stay inert, and links enable only after streaming settles.
Inline and hover image previews through the desktop file route, the lightbox round trip, bare-space path recovery and the image-only-link single-activation rule.

552-line suite proving a streamed MarkdownText matches a fresh render at every prefix (chunk sizes 1/3/7/16), keeps frozen DOM nodes across freezes, recovers from divergence, and never freezes under a position-less grammar.
Path-image resolution applies only to settled renders and URL promotion wins before the resolver sees a token.
Plain-text projection of a GFM document, its first-line and first-paragraph modes, raw HTML preserved literally and tables projected as tab-separated rows.
Hand-built mdast trees exercise the renderer's defensive arms (unresolved references, duplicate definitions, bare list items) and StrictMode double-render parity.
Test wrappers that inject the shared labels into MarkdownText and JsonBlock so the specs exercise the public API.

603-line suite for the markdown surface: CJK strong emphasis, inline-code URL promotion, delegated link handling, file mentions, fence streaming, image and HTML neutralization, and the full TeX delimiter matrix.
388-line suite for menu groups: naming, the two-observer sticky transition, observer ownership and the no-IntersectionObserver fallback.
Menu surface exposes the shared material and the macOS backing as a separate non-interactive layer.
182-line suite for the modal layer: only the top modal closes, a newer menu or dialog blocks it, Escape closes one layer, IME is honoured, and each opener is restored.
Path label clipping detection and the left-edge fade attribute.
Plugin artwork renders with per-instance gradient ids and a fixed 36x36 viewBox.
Fuzzy ranker: subsequence matching, prefix hits first, boundary/adjacency scoring, a display label as a second key and source order for ties.
highlightLines contract (terminator line dropped, per-line spans, undefined for an unknown language) plus the read card's window note, cap and empty-file copy refusal.
Relative-time buckets and their boundaries, including a future moment reading as the present.
Search card: file groups with collapsing, the pre-cap total folded into the summary, the flat path shape and the copy failure path.
Segmented control: named tablist, owner-held selection, disabled options, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End walking and no form submission.
Segmented tabs: only the selected tab is a tab stop, keyboard selection moves focus, and the panels stay caller-owned.

152-line suite for the settings controls: staging without writing, the reset offered only while an override stands, the invalid draft replacing the hint, and the secret field never rendering its value.
319-line suite for the staged form model: failed credential writes reported, drafts retained after a transport failure and retryable, override detection by presence, and unavailable namespaces.
Settings form frame: the unavailable and read-only notices, the save blocked while invalid or saving, and discard on unmount.
Reads StateDot.module.css as text to assert each state's colour rule, the spinner keyframes and the reduced-motion fallback.
State dot rendering: the done/warning/error/idle arms, the step appearance and the spinner element.
299-line suite for the streaming fence arm: incremental tokenization equals from-scratch at every prefix, completed lines keep their spans, and the streaming tree survives the settled shiki swap.
Switch exposes its state and caller-owned name, reports the requested state, stays silent while disabled and never submits a surrounding form.
